browser.description: Browser webviews (label browser-*) hold an empty capability set: no invoke, no event listeners, no filesystem, no shell. This file exists to declare that deny-by-default posture in the open — a label no capability mentions would be equally safe and much easier to widen by accident. src-tauri/src/browser/ parses this file and fails the build's test leg if any permission is ever added here, or if any other capability's window/webview globs start reaching browser labels. Matched on `webviews`, not `windows`: a browser page is a child webview of the main window, and a window-matched grant would be inherited by every child seated in it.

default.description: Default capability: the app's own webview may invoke the engine-bridge commands, listen to shell events, and read the app's name/version, and nothing else. Matched on `webviews: ["main"]`, NOT `windows: ["main"]` — the main window hosts untrusted child webviews (browser-*) alongside the UI's own, and a child reports its parent's window label; a window-matched grant would be inherited by every page seated in the window and hand the whole `codify_*` surface to untrusted content. Grants only the minimal core permissions the UI actually uses instead of `core:default`, plus the `shell` permission set (src-tauri/permissions/shell.json) which names every `codify_*` command one by one.
